Standards Authority Of ... on 31 October, 2025
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice Laxmi Narayana Alishetty

This writ petition is filed seeking following relief:
"To declare the action of the respondents in high handedly threatening to close the units of the petitioners, as illegal and arbitrary."
2.
Sri Pasham Mohith Reddy, learned Standing counsel for respondent No.3 present.
3. No representation on behalf of the petitioner despite listing the matter under the caption "For Dismissal".
It appears that petitioner has no interest to pursue the matter.
4. Accordingly, this writ petition is dismissed for non- prosecution.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, shall stand dismissed.

LAXMI NARAYANA ALISHETTY, J DATE:
